scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_CONTROL --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_TENANT_DEFAULT --local
scripts.migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_CONTROL --remote --env staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_TENANT_DEFAULT --remote --env staging
scripts.migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_CONTROL --remote --env production && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB_TENANT_DEFAULT --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run migrate:staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run migrate:production && wrangler deploy --env production
